_validation_method.description: How free model statuses were determined.
_validation_method.procedure: Direct API calls per provider. Cerebras models re-tested 2026-05-27 after deprecation date — all three still functional.

key_findings.burst_vs_persistent: Most free models that 429 on first request also 429 on every subsequent request, even with 5s delays. This indicates persistent rate limiting, not just burst protection.
key_findings.single_call_insufficient: A single successful API call does NOT mean a model is not rate limited. Several models succeed once but fail on every subsequent request.
key_findings.model_id_format: OpenRouter API calls should NOT use the 'openrouter/' prefix. Use 'provider/model:free' format.
key_findings.gemini_4_31b: 1/6 requests succeeded (3rd delayed attempt) — effectively rate limited, not reliably usable.
key_findings.parallel_load: Running all models in parallel via Start-Job causes intermittent 429s even on reliable models. Sequential testing recommended for final validation.
